description_zh: 卡尔·古斯塔夫·埃米尔·曼纳海姆 (1867-1951) 芬兰元帅/总统 (1944-1946)/俄罗斯/帝国/将军/1918 内战/白军/1939 冬季战争/苏联/入侵/曼纳海姆/防线/1941 继续战争/德国/合作/1944 停战/总统/中立/北欧/平衡/遗产/芬兰/曼纳海姆。核心模式：冬季战争中立建国 — 冬季战争/防线/继续/停战/总统/中立/北欧/平衡/遗产/曼纳海姆/芬兰。体现 M257 冬季战争/中立/国家建构 — 以"冬季战争+防线+停战+中立"四位一体，在苏联/德国/内战/地缘四重夹击中构建芬兰冬季战争中立建国范式。
description_en: Carl Gustaf Emil Mannerheim (1867-1951) Finnish Marshal/President (1944-1946)/Russian Empire/general/1918 civil war/Whites/1939 Winter War/Soviet/invasion/Mannerheim/Line/1941 Continuation War/Germany/cooperation/1944 armistice/President/neutrality/Nordic/balance/legacy/Finland/Mannerheim. Core model: Winter War Neutral Nation-Building — winter war/line/continuation/armistice/president/neutrality/Nordic/balance/legacy/Mannerheim/Finland. Exemplifies M257 Winter War/Neutrality/Nation-Building — quaternity of 'winter war + line + armistice + neutrality' building Finnish winter war neutral nation-building paradigm amid quadruple squeeze of USSR/Germany/civil war/geopolitics.
reason_zh: 曼纳海姆非单纯军人，而是"冬季战争+防线+停战+中立"四位一体国家守护者。以曼纳海姆防线延缓苏军，以继续战争争取喘息，以停战/总统引领中立转型。M257 区隔于 M255 瓦伦伯格外交(瓦伦伯格)、M256 格伦德维教育(格伦德维)、M258 爱沙尼亚数字(伦纳特)，核心在于"冬季战争即生存考验+防线即战略锚点+停战即政治智慧+中立即长期生存"的芬兰冬季战争中立建国范式。
reason_en: Mannerheim not mere soldier but 'winter war + line + armistice + neutrality' quaternity national guardian. Mannerheim Line delayed Soviet advance, Continuation War bought breathing space, armistice/presidency led neutral transition. M257 distinct from M255 Wallenberg Diplomacy (Wallenberg), M256 Grundtvig Education (Grundtvig), M258 Estonia Digital (Lennart), core: 'winter war as survival test + line as strategic anchor + armistice as political wisdom + neutrality as long-term survival' Finnish winter war neutral nation-building paradigm.
